Roach Chiropractic Centre located in Bedford, Nova Scotia focuses on treating pain associated with injuries to the lower back, upper back, shoulder and neck, carpal tunnel, knee, sciatica, hip, and more. 

Dr. Clayton Roache and Dr. Ben Boudreau have also developed a patient education program and regularly give Corporate Lunch and Learn presentations to help build a healthier workforce. They have touched the lives of thousands of people and families within Bedford (NS), Sackville (NS), Halifax (NS) and Dartmouth (NS) getting people to their optimal health potential, taking away their pain, increasing their quality of life and being their trusted wellness doctor.

Roach Chiropractic has been providing excellent chiropractic care and empowering patients to live their best lives since 2005. 
Visit us at www.roachchiropractic.com or call 902-404-3828 to get started on your path to health and wellness.
